name: memory-with-files
description: Persist durable project context in repo-local files without managing task status.

interface.shortDescription: Durable project memory without task planning.
interface.longDescription: Stores decisions, findings, and handoff context under each project's .memory directory while Superpowers or OpenSpec remains authoritative for task status.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use memory-with-files to preserve durable context for this project.
